description: ROUTE DU RHUM 2014 - Implantation des bateaux dans le port de Saint-Malo is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Saint-Malo. Geographical location of competing boats, on pontoons and docks in the inner basins of the port of Saint-Malo The files are provided as of October 7, 2014. Depending on the final registrations and the results of the qualifications, the location may vary up to the date of departure, 2 November 2014. Coverage: Ville de Saint-Malo. The portal shows the English title as "Route DU RHUM 2014 — Implantation of boats in the port of Saint-Malo" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Saint-Malo. The listing shows 3 download or service links in ZIP, KML, CSV. The listing shows 2016-01-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
